strings.zh: 贴着传单！{SCROLL}最近有不守礼节的训练家{NEWLINE}在地下通道{CLEAR}进行精灵对决,{SCROLL}因附近居民对此投诉,{CLEAR}故封闭地下通道！{CLEAR}　　　　……彩虹市警察
strings.en: There’s a notice posted!{SCROLL}Recently, ill-mannered Trainers have{NEWLINE}been holding Pokémon battles in the{CLEAR}Underground Path.{SCROLL}Due to complaints from local residents,{NEWLINE}the Underground Path is closed!{SCROLL}...Celadon City Police
strings.notes: US 0336/0 | RV011: addition: US line added 'rising'/'indefinitely'; aligned with sibling signs 0322#48, 0327#58

strings.zh: 下面是地下通道。{SCROLL}通过金黄市的地下,{NEWLINE}可以从彩虹市{CLEAR}到达紫苑镇。
strings.en: The Underground Path is down below.{SCROLL}It runs under Saffron City, from{NEWLINE}Celadon City to Lavender Town.

strings.zh: 小霞『水之波动,宝石海星！
strings.en: Misty: Starmie, Water Pulse!

strings.zh: 火精灵使用晴天！
strings.en: Flareon, use Sunny Day!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,在我的晴天之下{NEWLINE}你的水系优势就没有了！
strings.en: Heh heh! Under my harsh sunlight, your{NEWLINE}Water-type advantage is gone!

strings.zh: 小霞『挺有两下子的嘛,{NEWLINE}不过我的宝石海星还有绝招哦。{CLEAR}使出水炮！
strings.en: Misty: Not bad at all! But my Starmie{NEWLINE}still has a trump card. Hydro Pump!

strings.zh: 快避开啊火精灵！
strings.en: Flareon, dodge it!

strings.zh: 火精灵,回来吧！
strings.en: Flareon, come back!
Misty: {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 小霞『是啊,自从上次分别后,{NEWLINE}我就一直在华蓝道馆修行,{CLEAR}这次出来到草系道馆锻炼,{CLEAR}没想到就遇到了你。
strings.en: Misty: Yeah! Since we split up last time,{NEWLINE}I’ve been training at the Cerulean Gym.{SCROLL}This time I came out to train at the{NEWLINE}Grass-type Gym, and I never expected{CLEAR}to run into you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好久不见啊,小霞。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Long time no see, Misty.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好久不见了呢,小霞。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s been a long time, Misty!

strings.zh: 小霞『这些精灵是野生的吗？{NEWLINE}看起来很狂躁啊。{CLEAR}好久没有跟你并肩作战了{VAR:0103:0},{CLEAR}你有信心压制住它们吗？
strings.en: Misty: Are these Pokémon wild? They{NEWLINE}look really worked up.{SCROLL}It’s been ages since we fought side by{NEWLINE}side, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Think you can hold them off?
{VAR:0103:0}: Of course!

strings.zh: 小霞『明明已经受伤这么严重了,{NEWLINE}非但没有倒下,反而还更加狂躁……
strings.en: Misty: They’re this badly hurt, and{NEWLINE}instead of going down, they’re getting{CLEAR}even wilder...

strings.zh: 莉佳『臭臭花,{NEWLINE}使用香甜气息！
strings.en: Erika: Gloom, use Sweet Scent!

strings.zh: 波士可多拉和梦歌仙人掌恢复平静了。
strings.en: Aggron and Cacturne calmed down.

strings.zh: 莉佳『你们现在已经受伤了,{NEWLINE}进到精灵球里去好吗？{CLEAR}我带你们去治疗。
strings.en: Erika: You’re both hurt now. Won’t you{NEWLINE}come into a Poké Ball? I’ll take you to{CLEAR}get treated.

strings.zh: 莉佳『好的,进来吧！
strings.en: Erika: That’s right. In you come!

strings.zh: 莉佳『你没事吧？有受伤吗？
strings.en: Erika: Are you all right? Are you hurt?

strings.zh: 还好啦莉佳大小姐,{NEWLINE}只是轻微擦伤而已。
strings.en: I’m fine, Lady Erika. It’s just a{NEWLINE}scratch.
strings.notes: | RV011: voice: 莉佳大小姐 = 'Lady Erika' as everywhere else (D-0589)

strings.zh: 小霞『莉佳！
strings.en: Misty: Erika!

strings.zh: 莉佳『那就好。
strings.en: Erika: I’m glad to hear it.

strings.zh: 莉佳『小霞,你怎么在这里啊？
strings.en: Erika: Misty, what are you doing here?

strings.zh: 小霞『嘿嘿,我特地来找你{NEWLINE}帮我做一下针对弱点的特训。
strings.en: Misty: Hee hee!{SCROLL}I came all this way to ask you to help{NEWLINE}me train to cover my weaknesses.

strings.zh: 莉佳『当然没问题。{NEWLINE}不过也不急在这一时,{CLEAR}先去我们香水店看看怎么样？
strings.en: Erika: Of course.{SCROLL}But there’s no rush. Why don’t we stop{NEWLINE}by my perfume shop first?

strings.zh: 小霞『好呀好呀,{NEWLINE}我好久都没逛商场了呢。
strings.en: Misty: Yes, yes! I haven’t been{NEWLINE}shopping at the mall in forever!

strings.zh: 莉佳『那咱们走吧！
strings.en: Erika: Then let’s go!

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0},刚刚使用臭臭花的{NEWLINE}是彩虹道馆的馆主莉佳哦,{CLEAR}她跟吔花姐姐是好朋友,{CLEAR}所以跟我也很熟悉。{CLEAR}我现在跟莉佳去她店里看看,{CLEAR}你有空也一起来吧。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, that was Erika with the{NEWLINE}Gloom just now.{SCROLL}She’s the Celadon Gym Leader.{SCROLL}She’s good friends with my big sister{NEWLINE}Daisy, so I know her well too.{SCROLL}I’m going to check out her shop with{NEWLINE}her now.{SCROLL}Come along too if you have time!

strings.zh: 小霞『嘿嘿,是我赢了！
strings.en: Misty: Hee hee! I win!

strings.zh: 莉佳『小霞？
strings.en: Erika: Misty?

strings.zh: 你好,我正在这一带进行特训,{NEWLINE}你能陪我来一场对战吗？
strings.en: Hi! I’m training around here. Will you{NEWLINE}have a battle with me?

strings.zh: 对伊布使用不同的进化石,{NEWLINE}就可以让它进化成不同的形态。{SCROLL}我的火精灵就是对伊布{NEWLINE}使用火之石后进化而来的。
strings.en: Use different evolution stones on{NEWLINE}Eevee, and it evolves in different ways.{SCROLL}My Flareon evolved from an Eevee when I{NEWLINE}used a Fire Stone on it.

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意陪我练习,{NEWLINE}期待跟你的下一次对战。
strings.en: Thanks for training with me. I’m looking{NEWLINE}forward to our next battle.

strings.zh: 期待跟你的下一次对战。
strings.en: I’m looking forward to our next battle.

strings.zh: 我守在这里只是想跟{NEWLINE}路过的训练家对战,{CLEAR}结果却被野生的精灵袭击,{CLEAR}真是太倒霉了……
strings.en: I’ve been waiting here to battle{NEWLINE}Trainers passing by, but then wild{CLEAR}Pokémon attacked me. Just my luck...

strings.zh: 火精灵『Fla——re！
strings.en: Flareon: Fla-re!

strings.zh: Agg——ron！
strings.en: Agg-ron!

strings.zh: Caaa——tu！
strings.en: Caaa-tu!

strings.zh: 阿桔『我试过了各种毒液,{NEWLINE}都无法溶化前面的这层屏障。{CLEAR}不知道志霸先生的绝对力量{CLEAR}或者菊子女士和娜姿小姐的超能力{CLEAR}能不能破开这道屏障。
strings.en: Koga: I have tried every kind of venom,{NEWLINE}and none can dissolve this barrier{CLEAR}before us.{SCROLL}I wonder whether Bruno’s sheer{NEWLINE}strength, or the psychic powers of{CLEAR}Agatha and Sabrina, could break{CLEAR}through it.

strings.zh: 末入蛾『Veee——no！
strings.en: Venomoth: Veee-no!

strings.zh: 莉佳『{VAR:0103:0},我还以为{NEWLINE}火箭队基地被端掉之后,{CLEAR}他们也就没有继续作恶的资本了。{CLEAR}没想到他们反而{CLEAR}大张旗鼓地占领了一座城市。{CLEAR}到底火箭队还隐藏了多少实力啊……
strings.en: Erika: {VAR:0103:0}, I thought that once{NEWLINE}Team Rocket’s base was taken down,{CLEAR}they wouldn’t have the means to keep{CLEAR}doing evil.{SCROLL}Instead, they’ve boldly taken over an{NEWLINE}entire city.{SCROLL}Just how much strength is Team Rocket{NEWLINE}still hiding...

strings.zh: 叶精灵『Lea——on！
strings.en: Leafeon: Lea-on!

strings.zh: 渡『我骑着快龙{NEWLINE}从金黄市的上方查看过了,{CLEAR}这道屏障连上方的天空都包裹着。{CLEAR}目前完全没有发现进入金黄市的路。{CLEAR}火箭队到底在金黄市做什么呢,{CLEAR}真是让人担心。
strings.en: Lance: I flew over Saffron City on{NEWLINE}Dragonite to take a look.{SCROLL}This barrier even covers the sky above{NEWLINE}the city. So far, I haven’t found any{CLEAR}way into Saffron City.{SCROLL}What is Team Rocket doing in there? It’s{NEWLINE}troubling.

strings.zh: 快龙『Dra——gon！
strings.en: Dragonite: Dra-gon!

strings.zh: 大吾『{VAR:0103:0},我刚要挑战浅红道馆,{NEWLINE}阿桔先生就接到精灵联盟的通知{CLEAR}要来解决金黄市的突发情况。{CLEAR}我本来以为四天王和馆主们齐聚这里,{CLEAR}一定能迅速解决事件。{CLEAR}谁知道现在连金黄市都进不去,{CLEAR}更别提跟火箭队战斗了。
strings.en: Steven: {VAR:0103:0}, I was just about to{NEWLINE}challenge the Fuchsia Gym when Koga was{CLEAR}notified by the Pokémon League that he{CLEAR}had to come deal with the emergency in{CLEAR}Saffron City.{SCROLL}I thought that with the Elite Four and{NEWLINE}the Gym Leaders all gathered here, this{CLEAR}would be settled quickly.{SCROLL}Who knew we couldn’t even get into{NEWLINE}Saffron City, let alone fight{CLEAR}Team Rocket?
strings.notes: | RV011: omission: 跟火箭队战斗 named Team Rocket; removed stray split ellipsis

strings.zh: 巨金怪『Meta——gro！
strings.en: Metagross: Meta-gro!

strings.zh: 那边不就是四天王的渡先生吗！？{NEWLINE}没想到竟然能在这里看到自己的偶像。
strings.en: Isn’t that Lance of the Elite Four over{NEWLINE}there?! I never thought I’d get to see{CLEAR}my idol here!

strings.zh: 前面有一道看不见的屏障,{NEWLINE}无法再向前走了。
strings.en: There’s an invisible barrier ahead. You{NEWLINE}can’t go any farther.
